summary: Adversarially verify the D.9 FP8-build gate verdict (REACHED / QUALITY-LIMITED / frontier)

reviews.headline_claim: >=85% MFU and <=0.3% PPL are NOT co-satisfiable on measured evidence: full-coverage FP8 = 92-98% MFU at +0.37% PPL (quality FAIL) vs the only quality-passing config (per-channel, down_proj kept fp16, 73% GEMM-time coverage) = +0.2465% PPL PASS at ~80% MFU (DERIVED, not gate-grade). Per-tensor drop_downproj hits 85.9% MFU on a measured rate but is off-method and its PPL is unmeasured.
reviews.binding_constraint: Quality, specifically the SwiGLU down_proj (27% of GEMM-time): it must stay fp16 to meet PPL<=0.3%, and removing it from FP8 coverage is exactly what drops MFU below the 85% bar. The 700W lock is a secondary wall (caps FP8 at ~half its 1979 native peak) but the PPL/down_proj coupling is what makes the two gates mutually exclusive.
reviews.mfu_model_trust: Blend STRUCTURE is sound (Amdahl time-partition, coverage correctly GEMM-time-weighted at 73% not count-weighted 86%, arithmetic reproduces 85.9%/79.4% exactly); but the per-channel ~80% is double-bridged — a single-shape GEMM ratio (0.886) flat-multiplied onto 4-shape end-to-end vLLM MFU that includes non-GEMM work, plus per-channel was never run in vLLM at all (env-block). Treat ~77-86% as a plausibility band: trustworthy enough to say not-demonstrated, NOT gate-grade to certify REACHED.
reviews.top_confound: Direct vLLM prefill MFU of the on-method config (per-channel weight + per-token activation, down_proj fp16, 73% coverage) at sustained 700W, prefix-cache off, vs 989 bf16. One real measurement deletes the entire derived chain. Blocker to clear: the llm-compressor <-> vLLM _C.abi3.so ABI conflict (build per-channel weights offline in a separate env, then load into clean vLLM).

reviews.headline_claim: ~80% MFU at <0.3% PPL (per-channel FP8, down_proj kept fp16, C=73%); full-coverage FP8 hits 88-98% MFU but at +0.37% PPL which FAILS the locked 0.3% bar. The honest within-bar number is ~80%, BELOW 85% — not REACHED.
reviews.binding_constraint: SwiGLU down_proj quality under PER-TOKEN activation scaling vs the locked 0.3% PPL bar. The gated-activation product silu(gate)*up creates channel-correlated outliers that per-token (per-row) scaling cannot capture, so down_proj is the PPL bottleneck and is forced to fp16 (C drops to 73%). On the ONLY quality-passing scheme (per-channel weight, which has ~11% slower GEMM, ratio 0.886), 85% MFU needs C>=0.89 but quality only passes at C=0.73 -> ~80%. The two frontier points (fast=per-tensor, quality-clean=per-channel-low-coverage) are not the same config, so they cannot be co-claimed.
reviews.mfu_model_trust: Harmonic-blend (Amdahl-on-GEMM-fraction) model is sound and the per-tensor->per-channel 0.886 bridge is a real first-party microbench; BUT the specific 85.9% headline is untrustworthy because it applies r_fp8=0.983 (per-TENSOR MFU) to the per-CHANNEL quality-passing config — a scheme mismatch. Apply the correct per-channel rate and the same model gives ~80%. Model trustworthy, the 85.9% application is not; no per-tensor drop_downproj PPL was ever measured to justify the pairing.
reviews.top_confound: Finer down_proj treatment that was NOT tested: block/group activation scaling (DeepSeek-V3-style 128-wide sub-channel) or SmoothQuant migration of down_proj outliers into weights, or per-channel activation. "down_proj must stay fp16" is over-strong — it is "must stay fp16 UNDER per-token scaling." The over-bar margin is tiny (all-fp8 per-channel +0.37%, only 0.07pp over; down_proj contributes ~0.12pp), so a finer down_proj scheme could plausibly keep it in FP8 within 0.3%, lifting coverage to ~100% -> per-channel MFU 88-98% -> flip to REACHED. Dropping the WHOLE down_proj (27% GEMM-time) is the coarsest fix, not the minimal one. This single measurement would most change the verdict.

reviews.headline_claim: No single config co-satisfies the LOCKED gates: full-coverage FP8 = 98.3% MFU at +0.37% PPL (FAILS 0.3% quality); the quality-passing config (per-channel weight, down_proj held fp16, 73% coverage) = +0.25% PPL at ~80% MFU modeled (FAILS 85%). REACHED at 92-98% MFU is available ONLY if the bar is relaxed to <0.5% PPL, which was not LOCKED.
reviews.binding_constraint: The SwiGLU down_proj (27% of GEMM-time) must stay fp16 to hold PPL<=0.3%, and fp16 prefill runs at only 64% MFU under the 700W lock; the harmonic blend at the resulting 73% coverage cannot clear 85% in the per-channel (quality-passing) scheme. Formally: MFU>=85% needs coverage >=89-93% (per-channel), PPL<=0.3% needs coverage <87.5% (87.5% measured-fails) — the feasible coverage regions are disjoint. The 0.3% LOCKED bar is the policy lever that makes them disjoint.
reviews.mfu_model_trust: Directionally trustworthy, point-estimate soft: the ~80% is doubly modeled (harmonic blend + a single-shape GEMM per-tensor/per-channel ratio) with errors both ways (ignores fp8/fp16 re-quant boundary overhead -> biases high; uses end-to-end fp16 0.64 for one big down_proj GEMM -> may bias low), and it violates the prereg's LOCKED single-engine rule (quality is HF/per-channel, MFU is vLLM/per-tensor). But the <85%-at-bar CONCLUSION is robust: even most-optimistic inputs (per-tensor 0.983, best shape, zero blend overhead) cap MFU@73% at 85.87% and that requires the wrong (quality-FAILING) scheme; any realistic per-channel penalty drives it to ~79-80%. The JSON's 85.9% is an artifact of borrowing the per-tensor rate for a per-channel config.
reviews.top_confound: The env-blocked direct measurement: end-to-end vLLM per-channel-weight/per-token-activation prefill MFU at 700W with down_proj held fp16 (the actual 73%-coverage quality-passing config), blocked by llm-compressor breaking vLLM's compiled _C.abi3.so. Everything else (both coverages' quality, per-tensor MFU, the GEMM bridge ratio) is directly measured; this single number is modeled and the verdict hinges on it. It does not block shipping the verdict — the 85.87% absolute ceiling (via the wrong scheme) already bounds the realistic per-channel value below 85%, so the measurement would confirm not overturn. >=85% -> REACHED; <85% (expected) -> confirms not-co-satisfiable.

reviews.headline_claim: Full-coverage FP8 prefill reaches 91.7-98.3% MFU vs the 989 bf16 reference (only 46-49% vs the FP8-native 1979 peak; 700W wall stands) but at +0.37% (per-channel) to +0.48% (per-tensor) WikiText-2 PPL, FAILING the locked 0.3% bar. The only PPL-passing config keeps the SwiGLU down_proj in fp16 (73% FP8 coverage, +0.25% PPL, MEASURED PASS both schemes) and models ~82-86% MFU -- a straddle that is NEVER directly measured (vLLM mixed-config env-blocked). No single config DEMONSTRATES >=85% MFU at <=0.3% PPL. Honest framing on lossless: +0.37% is "essentially lossless" by the broad literature (<0.5%/<1%), MMLU passes, true KL 0.0036 nats is well inside the 0.01 diagnostic -- but it misses the SELF-LOCKED 0.3% bar, which was locked precisely to forbid this post-hoc relaxation; the bar is not relaxed.
reviews.binding_constraint: The locked <=0.3% PPL hard gate. The SwiGLU down_proj is the PPL bottleneck in BOTH per-tensor and per-channel schemes (measured: keeping it fp16 drops PPL from +0.37-0.48% to +0.25%); to pass quality it must stay fp16, capping FP8 coverage at 73% (it is 27% of GEMM-time). At that coverage the harmonic-blended prefill MFU straddles 85% (84.7% at cov70, 85.9% at cov73 best-shape, 82.1% at worst measured shape) and is unmeasured end-to-end.
reviews.mfu_model_trust: Not trustworthy at the +-1pp precision the 85% verdict needs. The harmonic blend is a sound first-order model and the per-tensor->per-channel GEMM bridge (0.886x) is a single-shape ratio, but the only >=85% number (85.9%) rides two stacked optimistic choices -- the best of four measured shapes (r_fp8=0.983; worst shape gives 82.1%) and the full-model fp16 MFU (0.64) as an unvalidated proxy for the down_proj-fp16 GEMM rate. Directionally mid-80s, but it cannot discriminate REACHED from MFU-LIMITED; no mixed-config MFU was ever measured.
reviews.top_confound: A direct vLLM end-to-end prefill-MFU measurement of the down_proj-fp16 mixed-precision config (the within-bar 73%-coverage config), currently env-blocked by the llm-compressor/vLLM _C.abi3.so break and the cipher_kv_bridge py3.10/3.12 mismatch. It is the single measurement that flips MFU-LIMITED <-> REACHED; everything else (PPL, MMLU, KL, all-fp8 MFU) is already measured.
